value.rationale: Uniform bounded-run self-shuffle is a newly studied quantitative invariant of a classical self-generating word. Improving its published explicit Kolakoski bound by a factor of twelve (48 to 4) is structural, not an arbitrary small parameter improvement, and the result applies to all infinite smooth words with infinitely many parity returns. The exact minimal four-consecutive-even-length window at 38 is motivated by the proved maximal parity-atom length 8; negative certificates make that cutoff sharp within its natural finite-assembly method.
